_comment: Guided tour of the pixel-wise MLE tool in the emtk window. Steps point at real controls and wait for the user to use them.

steps.title: What this tool computes
steps.text: For every pixel of a confocal image it fits a fluorescence decay by Poisson maximum likelihood against the instrument response and shows the fitted lifetime (tau) as a map. It is slow and exact where the phasor is fast and model-free. You press the buttons; the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Start with data whose answer you know
steps.text: Load example writes a simulated polarisation-resolved FLIM image, a left half with a lifetime of 1.5 ns and a right half with 3.5 ns, together with the instrument response that goes with it, and fills in the matching channels and fit window. The lifetime map must show two plateaus at those values.

steps.title: The photon files and the IRF
steps.text: With your own data, Add files opens a chooser that takes several confocal TTTR files (PTU/HT3/...); Database picks a registered dataset; files can be dropped on the window. The IRF is the instrument response measurement, the first file is used; without it the decay cannot be deconvolved.

steps.title: Channels and fit window
steps.text: Name the routing channels that form the parallel and the perpendicular detection (they must be different), and the micro-time window Fit start to Fit stop (after binning) the likelihood is evaluated on.

steps.title: Minimum photons
steps.text: Pixels with fewer photons in the fit window are not fitted: a decay of a handful of photons has no lifetime.

steps.title: The fit model
steps.text: fit23 fits one lifetime plus anisotropy, fit24 a bi-exponential, fit25 picks the best of four fixed lifetimes. Each model keeps its own initial values and fixed flags.

steps.title: Fit
steps.text: Run fits every selected file pixel by pixel in the background and writes <stem>_pixel_mle.csv next to each file.

await.hint: Press Run and wait until the status line is empty.

steps.title: The lifetime map
steps.text: The fitted lifetime of every pixel; pixels that were not fitted draw as the colormap floor. Result switches between the analysed files and the frame slider scrubs a stack.
